params.prompt: Rendered circular badge logo, square composition, no text. A dark round badge with a thick beveled brushed-metal rim, like a premium app icon, over a charcoal background with soft vignette. Inside the badge: a deep navy globe with cyan-teal meridians, and in front of it a polished brass magnifying glass tilted to the lower right with a dark handle. The lens is thick translucent teal glass with real depth, refraction and a crisp highlight; inside the lens a golden route arc joins two golden dots. Dramatic studio lighting from the upper left, subtle reflections on the metal, high resolution, centered.
